title: Student health insurance: check your situation

shortSummary.text: Study, work and internships can lead to different insurance duties. Check your situation before choosing cover.

whoThisIsFor.text: International students, including those about to start work or an internship.

whenYouNeedIt.text: Before arrival and whenever work or internship arrangements change.

jurisdiction.note: National rules; local starting points for Leiden students.

prerequisites.text: Before arrival and whenever work or internship arrangements change.

requiredDocuments.text: Gather your study, work or internship details and current policy; check SVB’s actual application for required evidence.

estimatedTime.note: Assessment and policy start dates depend on the case; no processing promise is confirmed here.

estimatedCost.note: Premiums and own payments depend on the applicable insurance and policy. No universal student price is confirmed.

numberedSteps.title: Identify your situation
numberedSteps.body: For study only, Dutch basic insurance is usually not required. Work or a paid internship can change this; exceptions apply.

numberedSteps.title: Use the applicable SVB branch
numberedSteps.body: Read the current student and internship rules. Ask SVB for an assessment if your insurance position is unclear.

numberedSteps.title: Check actual cover
numberedSteps.body: Ask your insurer about the study period, existing conditions, hospital care and repatriation. Keep confirmation.

warnings.text: Do not buy a policy solely because another student has it.

commonMistakes.text: A Dutch address does not by itself establish every international student’s Wlz position.

tips.text: Once cover is clear, prepare to register with a GP.

checklist.text: For study only, Dutch basic insurance is usually not required. Work or a paid internship can change this; exceptions apply.
Read the current student and internship rules. Ask SVB for an assessment if your insurance position is unclear.
Ask your insurer about the study period, existing conditions, hospital care and repatriation. Keep confirmation.

faqs.question: Only studying?
faqs.answer: Check the study-only branch and its exceptions; still arrange suitable medical cover.

faqs.question: Starting a job?
faqs.answer: Recheck with SVB and your insurer before the change.

faqs.question: EHIC enough?
faqs.answer: Ask the home-country scheme about duration and coverage; the card alone does not describe all conditions.

emergencyInformation.text: This guide cannot decide your personal case. Use the responsible institution for help.

sections.title: Check before acting
sections.body: For internships, use the rules applying from September 2025. Residence, remuneration and employee insurance can matter.

nextActions.text: Once cover is clear, prepare to register with a GP.

disclaimer: YouNew explains official information. It is not a government service or personal legal or medical advice.
